messages:
maria: FYI customer reported streaming tool-call failing — args arrive as partial JSON, our schema validator throws "Unexpected end of input". customer request_id=req_0a1b2c

jake: Which SDK/version and region? any proxy in path?

maria: Node SDK 2.4.1, hosted us-east-1, going through our edge-proxy. Customer log:
```
ERROR validation: JSONParseError: Unexpected end of input
request_id=req_0a1b2c
```
Raw stream snippets from customer (chunks shown in order):
```
data: {"event":"tool_call","tool":"charge","args":

data: "{"amount": 100, "currency": "USD",
```
Note second chunk starts with a quote which is from the previous chunk's open brace — it's fragmented.

olivia: I can repro with curl against SSE endpoint when nginx chunk size is small. repro steps:
1) start local proxy with small buffer
2) curl --no-buffer -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -N "https://api.redwood.ai/stream"
I see events split mid-JSON. Example I captured:
```
chunk 1: data: {"id":"abc","type":"tool_call","tool":"charge","args":
chunk 2: {"amount":10,"currency":"USD","payment_id":"pm_123"}
```
Our stream parser only concatenates on newline and then parses full chunk as JSON — fails if splits inside braces.

jake: Can you run with REDWOOD_STREAM_DEBUG=1 on the edge-proxy and post incoming chunk boundaries? Also what proxy config? nginx/traefik?

olivia: Edge is nginx. Quick debug log:
```
[ingress] chunked: 72 bytes
[ingress] chunked: 48 bytes
[parser] assembled: "data: {\"id\":\"abc\",...\"args\":"
[parser] parse_error: Unexpected end of input
```

jake: Proposal: short-term hotfix in gateway to buffer SSE 'data:' fragments until a balanced braces heuristic or double newlines detected. Long-term: swap to incremental JSON parser (streaming) to handle fragments.

ryan: Patch idea for nginx to ensure 'proxy_buffering off;' and 'proxy_http_version 1.1; chunked_transfer_encoding on;' may help but not guaranteed. Alternative patch at runtime: change parser to accumulate bytes and attempt parse when brace depth returns to 0. PR #4321 adds that. Here's pseudo-config for nginx:
```
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_request_buffering off;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```

olivia: I opened PR #4321 with heuristic collector. Test build 2.4.2 includes client-side reassembly too. I deployed to staging, able to process fragmented chunks now.

maria: Customer applied SDK 2.4.2 and confirmed success. They tallied ~50 failed requests previously, now 0. Customer sent :party:.

deploy-bot: rolled out rdst/edge-fix/4321 to canary (10%) — monitor dashboards for 30m.

maria: closing after 24h no regressions. Thanks all :heart:
